A. Freeform text summary of the problems with the inefficiencies or failure modes in the trace: The workflow is highly inefficient and redundant. The Problem Solver agent single-handedly researches the data, performs the calculation, and arrives at the answer. The Code Executor then repeats the exact same calculation, which constitutes a Step Repetition. The roles are not well-utilized; a more efficient design would have the Problem Solver find the data and the Code Executor perform the calculation, avoiding the redundancy. The verification is weak; the Verifier agent simply notes that the other two agents arrived at the same numerical result from the same inputs, but it fails to perform any independent verification of the source data (the population and access figures), which is the most critical part of the problem.
